north_star: Make German legal research inspectable end to end so retrieval, citations, uncertainty and verification can be checked independently from generated prose.

achieved.title: Hybrid retrieval across 5,936 German federal laws
achieved.label: Hybrid retrieval

achieved.title: Paragraph graph, deterministic citation resolution and 53/53 citation regression
achieved.label: Citation graph

achieved.title: Research APIs and MCP tools with explicit human authority boundaries
achieved.label: MCP / APIs

current.title: Prove legal-answer quality beyond citation resolution
current.label: Answer quality
current.outcome: Move from strong retrieval/citation infrastructure to representative evidence that legal researchers can rely on the answer workflow and uncertainty handling.

next.title: Build a broader representative legal-answer benchmark
next.label: Answer benchmark
next.why: Citation correctness is necessary but not sufficient evidence of answer quality.

next.title: Run a law-firm research pilot with real edge cases and reviewer corrections
next.label: Law-firm pilot
next.why: Human reviewer evidence should expose where retrieval, framing or uncertainty still fails.

next.title: Turn every discovered research failure into a permanent regression
next.label: Failure regressions
next.why: The system should become more trustworthy through falsification, not confidence claims.

later.title: Expand source layers beyond federal statutes only when provenance remains inspectable.
later.label: More sources

later.title: Package legal research capabilities for bounded agent workflows through MCP/API contracts.
later.label: Agent contracts

later.title: Prove repeatable professional usefulness without autonomous consequential legal action.
later.label: Professional proof
